Title: Microsoft Patches 90 Vulnerabilities in August 2026 Patch Tuesday
Summary: Microsoft released fixes for 90 CVEs this month including 6 zero-days actively exploited in the wild. Security teams should prioritize deploying KB5041585 immediately.

Title: Windows 11 August Update Fixes Critical Remote Code Execution Bug
Summary: A critical RCE vulnerability in the Windows Print Spooler service has been patched. Attackers could exploit this remotely without authentication.

Title: August Patch Tuesday Addresses Windows Kernel Elevation of Privilege
Summary: Multiple kernel-level privilege escalation vulnerabilities patched this month. Security researchers from Google Project Zero reported several of these findings.

Title: Windows 11 24H2 Stability Improvements in August Update
Summary: The August cumulative update brings notable reliability improvements to File Explorer and Taskbar. Microsoft addressed over 15 non-security bugs reported through Windows Feedback Hub.

Title: Intune Admins: August Patch Tuesday Deployment Guide
Summary: Step-by-step guide for IT admins deploying the August Windows 11 update via Microsoft Intune. Includes ring deployment strategy and known issues to watch for.

Title: Known Issues: August Windows 11 Update Causing VPN Problems
Summary: Some users report VPN connectivity issues after installing KB5041585. Microsoft is investigating. Workaround: temporarily disable NDIS driver until hotfix is released.

Title: July 2026 Patch Tuesday: 78 CVEs Fixed Including MSHTML Zero-Day
Summary: Microsoft patched 78 vulnerabilities in July including a critical MSHTML zero-day being exploited in targeted attacks against enterprise networks.

Title: Windows 11 July Update Brings Security Fixes for Networking Stack
Summary: The July cumulative update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the Windows TCP/IP stack and SMB protocol that could allow remote attackers to crash systems.
